findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_financials, get_attachments, get_going_concern, get_internal_control · Private data: download_document, get_attachments · Public sink: get_financials, get_going_concern · Destructive: get_attachments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_financials, get_attachments, get_going_concern, get_internal_control · Private data: download_document, get_attachments · Public sink: get_financials, get_going_concern · Destructive: get_attachments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
